QuestInfo.name: Teo's Nostalgic Reminiscing I
QuestInfo.0: You hear that you can receive help from #b#p1002001##k in Lith Harbor...
QuestInfo.1: You meet #b#p1002001##k at Lith Harbor. #b#p1002001##k says that you remind him of his younger days when he was starting out on his adventures, and he would like to help you. He says first that you need to bring him #b50 #t4000016#s#k and #b50 #t4000004#s#k. For a talented explorer like you, this should be a piece of cake.
QuestInfo.2: You showed your potential to #b#p1002001##k, who you met in Lith Harbor. #b#p1002001##k recognized your potential and gave you some mesos that should come handy during your adventures.

0.0: Hey! Are you about to start an adventure? But you look a bit weak. When I was younger, I also used to roam the world. I miss those days.
0.1: At first, it was difficult because I was so ill prepared. Seeing you reminds me of all the hardships I faced as a young adventurer.
0.2: For some reason, I like you. If you can prove that you have the makings of a great adventurer, I will support you financially. Interested?

yes.0: All right. Please gather #b50 #t4000016#s#k and #b50 #t4000004#s#k for me, then maybe I'll admit you are talented.

no.0: I was only trying to help... If you change your mind, feel free to come back.

1.0: Wow, this is great! You got all of them so quickly. I definitely have an eye for talent. You'll become a great adventurer. I'm sure of it.

yes.0: Did you get the money? It's not much but it should be useful for someone just starting out. I hope you get stronger and come back soon.

item.0: Hmm... You haven't gotten all the items I asked you to get. Maybe I overestimated you. Hurry up and gather #b50 #t4000016#s#k and #b50 #t4000004#s#k. I know you can do it.
